title: Nova | Jobs and agents
description: Scheduler leadership, task worker throughput, and Studio Auto execution.

options.content: **Jobs and agents**  ·  Confirm the scheduler leader, then inspect queue depth, worker activity, run results, and duration.

panels.title: Scheduler scrape
panels.description: Prometheus scrape state. No data means this target is not configured.

panels.title: Leader active
panels.description: 1 means a scheduler owns the active leader lease.

panels.title: Pending + lag
panels.description: Stream lag plus pending deliveries, including work already in flight.

panels.title: Task worker scrape
panels.description: Prometheus scrape state. No data means this target is not configured.

panels.title: Pending + lag
panels.description: Redis consumer-group pending deliveries plus undelivered lag; reported by each task worker, so use the maximum.

panels.title: Agent worker scrape
panels.description: Prometheus scrape state. No data means this target is not configured.

panels.title: Agent poll and claim errors
panels.description: Errors while polling for work or claiming a queued run.

panels.title: Active migrations
panels.description: Migration jobs currently executing inside the task worker process.

panels.title: Terminal jobs/s
panels.description: Completed attempts that persisted a terminal outcome.

panels.title: Non-success/s
panels.description: Partial, failed, or interrupted terminal outcomes; unfinished attempts are shown separately.

panels.title: Unfinished/s
panels.description: An attempt that could not persist a terminal result; inspect worker logs and job state.

panels.title: Migration poll errors
panels.description: Polling, claiming, or reconciling a migration job failed.

panels.title: Active builds
panels.description: Search index builds currently executing in the API process.

panels.title: Last successful poll age
panels.description: No data means the backend has not completed a successful search poll, or its scrape is unavailable.

panels.title: Reconcile errors, 1h
panels.description: A top-level reconciliation error can also be counted as a poll error; do not add the two counts.

panels.title: Build duration, p95
panels.description: 95th percentile duration of completed build attempts.

panels.title: Indexing loop errors
panels.description: Repeated failures can leave builds pending or keep an active index stale.

panels.title: Loop age by process
panels.description: A rising line with a healthy scrape indicates a stalled process loop.
